name: Meridian Connector for QuickBooks
description:
This connector lets Claude securely read from and write to QuickBooks Online.

Some things you can do:
• Connect multiple QuickBooks Online companies to the same agent (great for booking intercompany JEs)
• Choose read-only or read-write access separately for each company
• Create arbitrary QuickBooks transactions, including journal entries
• Bulk-create invoices or import credit card transactions
• Upload and attach receipts and supporting files to QuickBooks transactions
• Automatically fill in your firm-specific reporting template
• The craziest use case I tried was "Clone the contents of QBO A into QBO B", and… it worked

_published_faq.name: How do I add Meridian Connector for QuickBooks to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Meridian Connector for QuickBooks to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://qbo-connector.meridian.pilot.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Meridian Connector for QuickBooks MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Meridian Connector for QuickBooks lists 63 MCP tools, including batch_entity_operations, create_attachment_upload, create_bill, create_bill_payment, create_customer, create_deposit, create_entity, create_expense, create_invoice, create_journal_entry, create_payload_upload, and create_sales_receipt.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Meridian Connector for QuickBooks?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Meridian Connector for QuickBooks in financial-services on the Manufact MCP catalog include Contract-Factory — Sociétés & SIREN, Kavara Kirk, CeylonCharts, Netzo, and Ramp Data.

_published_faq.name: Does Meridian Connector for QuickBooks MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Meridian Connector for QuickBooks requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.

_published_faq.name: Who develops Meridian Connector for QuickBooks?

acceptedAnswer.text: Meridian Connector for QuickBooks is developed by Pilot.com, Inc.. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
